title: React Three Fiber
description: React Three Fiber (R3F) is a React renderer for Three.js that brings declarative, component-based 3D graphics to the web. EML uses R3F to create interactive educational visualizations with the familiarity of React's development patterns.

projects.name: IMLE (Immersive Materials Learning Environment)
projects.description: Interactive 3D materials science modules built with React Three Fiber
